### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **17** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**6** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`  _(via inlineTitle (symbol, a field of interface ObjectFieldLike), inlineTitle (literal, a string literal in collectExpectedEntries; a string literal in lookupObjectFieldAttr; a string literal in translateObject))_
- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via globalFilters (literal, a string literal in packagedPart))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via bulkActionDefs (literal, a string literal in packagedPart))_
- `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx`  _(via bulkActionDefs (literal, a string literal in packagedPart))_
- `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`  _(via globalFilters (literal, a string literal in packagedPart))_
- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx`  _(via bulkActionDefs (literal, a string literal in packagedPart))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via globalFilters (literal, a string literal in packagedPart))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-6.mdx`  _(via globalFilters (literal, a string literal in packagedPart))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via ObjectFieldLike (symbol, a top-level interface), bulkActionDefs (literal, a string literal in packagedPart))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/system.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/system.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **55** of **207** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **154** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 88fb255cbac335cc97e9d148daadf164cfec2343` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c761fd0abc317684fe1af8353272fe79b868772b` — the merge of head `bcbc83749b5adc7aff859f5d2351a0b75cc1e3e1` into base `88fb255cbac335cc97e9d148daadf164cfec2343`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c761fd0abc317684fe1af8353272fe79b868772b && git checkout c761fd0abc317684fe1af8353272fe79b868772b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 88fb255cbac335cc97e9d148daadf164cfec2343 bcbc83749b5adc7aff859f5d2351a0b75cc1e3e1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 88fb255cbac335cc97e9d148daadf164cfec2343 && git merge --no-ff bcbc83749b5adc7aff859f5d2351a0b75cc1e3e1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 88fb255cbac335cc97e9d148daadf164cfec2343
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 88fb255cbac335cc97e9d148daadf164cfec2343` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

The head is the same at both readings and at the time of this write. Nothing was built, run or re-run; one `git fetch` of the head into the local checkout.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **#26112 acceptance holds end to end through the serving door.** `reports.REPORT.blocks.BLOCK.label` / `.description` is declared on the one `reports` entry shape (`translation.zod.ts:1183-1205`) that `appTranslationDataShape()` feeds to all four doors (`TranslationData`, `PlatformTranslationData`, `ServedTranslationData`, `TranslationItem`; `:1997`, `:2040`, `:2081`, `:2246`), closed with `strictObject` and `title` / `name` / `heading` aliased onto `label`. The key is stable: `JoinedReportBlockSchema.name` is `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` with no `.optional()` (`report.zod.ts:340`). `translateReport` (`i18n-resolver.ts:2345-2371`) now runs `translateReportBlocks` (`:2281-2310`), matching each served block to its packaged counterpart by `name` through `packagedPart(base, 'blocks', …)` and applying `valueOverridesPackagedBase` per block, so a block an org re-authored keeps its text, a block the packaged report never declared is treated as authored (`{}` from `packagedPart`), and no base supplied means the catalog applies — the same three answers the dashboard-widget and view-bulk-action translators give. Identity: an unaddressed block is returned as the same reference and a report none of whose keys match comes back as the input (pinned). The REST boundary localizes both list and item reads (`meta-item-read-gate.ts:2895-2926` and the item twin at `:2976-2985`) for every type in `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES`, which is derived from the dispatch table that already carries `report`, with `packagedBase` resolved through `PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` (`report` → `getPackagedReportBase`, `:2826`). The joined renderer draws `resolveText(block.label, block.name ?? …)` (`DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:1843-1845`) on the `report` prop handed down by `ReportRenderer` from `ReportView`, which takes `reports` from `useMetadata()` (`ReportView.tsx:56`) — the `GET /api/v1/meta/report` list the provider fetches through `meta.getItems` — so the translated string is what it reads; a translated block label is a plain string, which `resolveText` returns as is. The showcase pin asserts `[open_block, 未完成任务], [done_block, 已完成任务]` under the translated title.

2. **#26142 acceptance holds end to end through the serving door.** `FieldTranslationSchema.inlineTitle` (`translation.zod.ts:140`) is a plain `z.string().optional()`, and `FieldTranslationSchema` is the one schema every door's `fields` record reuses (`:282`), so the per-object door and the `translation` metadata type gain it together; a locale-map value is refused as `invalid_type` (pinned). `translateObject`'s field pass (`i18n-resolver.ts:3957-3960`) overlays it under the same `valueOverridesPackagedBase(packagedObjectField(…), 'inlineTitle', def.inlineTitle)` rule as `description`, and `lookupObjectFieldAttr` reads `objects.OBJ.fields.FIELD.inlineTitle` across the locale chain (`:3334-3336`). The console's `attachInlineSubforms` (`MetadataProvider.tsx:599-623`) copies `d.inlineTitle` as the subform `title` from the CHILD object's served field def; it runs inside `composeObjects` (`:678`) over the provider's stored `object` items, which are the `GET /api/v1/meta/object` list (`meta.getItems('object', …)`, `:1045`) — the REST-localized document — not a bundled copy. The one unserved path is the metadata-admin preview (`preview.list('object')`, `:1044`), which is the Studio draft preview and not the create form the card measured. The hotclm symptom (`clm_contract_version.fields.contract.inlineTitle`) is exactly the shape the spec test pins with `contract_version` / `contract`. The showcase pin covers `showcase_invoice_line.fields.invoice` and `showcase_expense_line.fields.expense_report`.

3. **The no-plural-fallback rule is consistent with `pages.title` and the other title attributes.** `translatePageHeaderTitle` resolves `pages.NAME.title` across the chain, else the header's AUTHORED title left as written (`i18n-resolver.ts:2469-2488`); `translateFormTitle` keeps the authored title on a missing key (`:1264`, `:1276`); dashboard widget `title` and the report's own `label` keep the authored string when unaddressed. In every case the bundle translates an attribute and never substitutes another attribute for authored text; the only "derive from another attribute" behaviour (a header with NO title) is the renderer's absent-value case, and the ui already draws the child's label when `inlineTitle` is absent (`attachInlineSubforms` only sets `title` when `d.inlineTitle` is truthy). The decision is stated in the schema TSDoc, the translator comment, the PR body, the changeset and #26759, and pinned by `i18n-field-inline-title.test.ts` (`amendment` keeps `Amended Versions`).

4. **Extract and check count both keys.** `collectExpectedEntries` pushes `objects.OBJ.fields.FIELD.inlineTitle` with `pushOptional` next to `placeholder` (`i18n-extract.ts:1393`), and `walkReports` walks `report.blocks[]` by the block's `name`, pushing `label` and `description` with `pushOptional` (`:1900-1908`), so an authored string is demanded and an unauthored one is recorded without an `inline`. `computeI18nCoverage` reaches the same entries, mapping `field` → `i18n/missing-field` and `report` → `i18n/missing-report` (`i18n-coverage.ts:331-361`); the cli test pins both the gap and its clearing. `check:i18n-walk-parity` is group-level by design (its header says a new leaf stays green there and the per-family pin tests carry it) — this PR adds that pin. The example rows are correct against the metadata: `showcase_task_overview` blocks are `open_block` / `done_block` with labels and no descriptions (`reports/index.ts:47-59`); `showcase_invoice_line.fields.invoice.inlineTitle: 'Line Items'` (`invoice.object.ts:219`); `showcase_expense_line.fields.expense_report.inlineTitle: 'Expense Lines'` (`expense-report.object.ts:156`); `crm_opportunity_line_item.fields.opportunity.inlineTitle: 'Products'` (`opportunity-line-item.object.ts:34`). Those four are the only authored `inlineTitle`s and the only joined report in `examples/`, so every new demanded key is translated at birth and the coverage baseline (`i18n-coverage-baseline.json`: crm 101 + showcase 320 + todo 106 = 527) is correctly unchanged; `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (hosts `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:i18n-walk-parity`) is green on this head.

5. **ui consumers that enumerate translation keys are unaffected.** `TranslationPreview.tsx:75` types `CATEGORY_DEFS` on `keyof TranslationDataSchema.shape` — top-level groups only; this PR adds no group, so the precedent of the `reports`-group card does not recur. `spec-translations.ts` `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS` is likewise top-level, and `transformSpecTranslations` forwards field members it does not flatten. `Type Check UI` and `Build & E2E UI` are green on this head.

6. **Generated artifacts agree with the source.** `api-surface` and `export-origins` gain `ReportBlockLike (interface)`; `authorable-surface` gains `system/FieldTranslation:inlineTitle` (the `reports` entry shape is an anonymous inline strict object, so its `blocks` leaf has no row there, as `label` / `description` have none); the strictness ledger moves 383 → 384 for the one new `strictObject` site; the liveness ledger adds `reports.blocks` with `label` / `description` children whose evidence anchors `#translateReportBlocks` / `#lookupReportBlockAttr` exist in the cited file (`Spec property liveness` green). `content/docs/references/**` changes are `gen:docs` output.

7. **Check-runs on the head (the gate verdicts).** At 2026-10-27T14:53Z: 17 success, 7 skipped, 19 in progress. At 2026-10-27T15:01Z: 40 success, 9 skipped (opt-in / matrix shells), 1 in progress — `Test Core (6/8)`. Green at that reading, among others: `Build Core` (hosts `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `ci.yml` job `build-core`), `Type Check · consumer gates` (hosts `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`, `lint.yml` job `typecheck-consumers`) — the two gates the dev left to CI (local exit 3) — plus `TypeScript Type Check`, `Type Check · source gates` / `workspace` / `debt ledger`, `Type Check UI`, `Spec property liveness`, `Check Changeset` (both), `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Test UI`, `Test Core` 1-5 and 7-8. `Test Core (6/8)` was in progress at the last reading: that is a reading, not a pass, and landing waits for it.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset** `.changeset/26112-26142-block-inline-title-translations.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`, `@objectstack/cli: minor`, body carries `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added` line-initial, and the PR body carries the same two lines. Right: the diff moves `packages/spec/src` and `packages/cli/src`, both published (`private` unset, 18.2.0, one `fixed` group); `examples/*` are `private: true`, `content/docs` and `docs/audits` publish nothing. The protocol kind `added` takes at least `minor` on every package the diff moves — both are `minor`. No breaking banner, no migration, no ADR-0087 marker is owed (nothing removed, renamed, refused or re-meant).
- **`Clause-②: yes`** — right. The accepted set widens (two new optional authorable keys on a strict face) and the public surface grows (`ReportBlockLike` export, `ReportLike.blocks`, `ObjectFieldLike.inlineTitle`). The `(widening)` arm would also be accurate and is optional; `yes` without an arm is a legal spelling.
- **`Metadata-protocol: added`** — right. Two new keys an author can write, no key narrowed, no meaning or default changed, so `added` is the one kind and the precedence rule does not bite.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Branch `claude/project-thread-2humd9` instead of `claude/issue-26112-slug`** — declared in the claim as the harness-pinned thread branch; `Implemented-by` below is that branch. Accepted.
2. **`DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` and `MetadataProvider.tsx` unchanged** — verified against the served path (①1, ①2): both read the REST-localized list the provider fetches; the only unserved read is the Studio preview, out of both cards' scope. Accepted.
3. **Two derived gates NOT MEASURED locally** (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 for want of a whole-repo build) — their CI counterparts, `Type Check · consumer gates` and `Build Core`, are green on this head (①7). Answered.
4. **Derived families 90-104 ran under a concurrent build lock** — the dev re-ran the ratchet / generated / i18n families clean at the head, and the CI jobs that host them (`TypeScript Type Check`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Spec property liveness`) are green. Answered.
5. **No reviewer request on the PR** — this record is the contract-tier review the claim's `--tier` line owes; nothing further is needed from the dev. Answered.
6. **cli integration tier not run locally** — `Test Core` shards 1-5, 7, 8 green; 6/8 in progress at the last reading. Open as a reading only; the seat lands when it completes.
7. **`Skills-docs: follow-up owed #26759`** — the card is right for what it names: `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md:162` (`fields.{field_name}` row: `label`, `help`, `placeholder`, `options`) and `:175` (`reports`, `positions` and `permissions` hold `label` + `description`) are the two sentences, both now incomplete, `skills/**` is Tier H, and the card's prescription (keys, the no-fallback rule, the `pages.{page}.components.{id}` analogy, one example row each) matches the shipped face. **Incomplete in one respect, escalated to the owning seat:** the hand-written author page `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` enumerates the same keys — `:71` (`objects.NAME.fields.FIELD.label / help / placeholder`) and `:85` (`reports.NAME.label / description`, the row the `reports` group landed with) — and now misses `inlineTitle` and `reports.NAME.blocks.BLOCK.label / description`; `content/docs/ui/` is hand-written and ungoverned, so no Tier H reason defers it, and no carrier names it (the docs-drift bot anchors on symbols and could not list it). Remedy, the seat's choice: push the two rows onto this PR (a doc-only change; a new head needs a fresh record) or add the file and lines to #26759's body so the owed edit has a carrier. Not a contract defect — the Zod face, the served door and the extract/check count are complete — so it does not move the verdict.
8. **Dev out-of-scope findings** — (a) `validate-translation-references` resolves `reports.NAME` but not `blocks.BLOCK` against that report's blocks: confirmed (`validate-translation-references.ts:2161-2165`; the rule's own header at `:55-66` says leaf-attribute shape is Zod's job, and `blocks` is a strict object so a bad leaf is refused at parse while a bad block NAME resolves nothing silently). Noted in the PR, not filed — consistent with Prime Directive #10 (no repro of a user-visible defect, a lint gap). One more line is now stale in that file's header: `:163` "Leaf keys below the name are the schema's (`label` / `description`, strict)" — ride it with #26759 or the next touch of that file. (b) `resolveText` reads an inline locale map's `default` member only (`DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:301-308`) — pre-existing, orthogonal to the bundle path, and a translated block label is a string. Accepted as noted.
9. **Docs-drift bot** — of the six hand-written pages it listed, `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx:213` authors `inlineTitle: 'Lines'` in an example and makes no claim about translation; the other five anchor on `packagedPart`'s pre-existing string literals, not on anything this diff changed in meaning. No page is falsified; the gap that matters is ③7.
10. **Clause-② arm omitted** — see ②; a legal spelling, no action.

## 维护者速读 (席位终稿)

- 改了什么：翻译包新增两个槽位，一个是联合报表每个区块的标题和说明（`reports.REPORT.blocks.BLOCK.label` / `.description`），另一个是主从字段内嵌表格的标题（`objects.CHILD.fields.FIELD.inlineTitle`）。服务端翻译器按请求语言覆盖这两处，`os i18n extract` / `check` 也开始统计这两个键。
- 为什么改：中文用户看联合报表时，报表标题是中文，区块标题却是英文；新建表单里的内嵌子表标题（如「Line Items」）也一直是英文。原因是翻译包里没有地方放这些译文，覆盖率检查也就看不到缺口。
- 风险与回滚：只新增可选键，已有翻译包和元数据不受影响。没有译文的内嵌标题保留作者原文，与报表标题同一规则。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`（`translateReportBlocks`，以及 `translateObject` 字段处理里的 `inlineTitle`）、`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`、`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/zh-cn-report-blocks-inline-titles.test.ts`，预期 3 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。技能文档和作者文档补两个键的工作挂在 #26759（`skills/**` 需人工合入）。

席位意见：接受。契约复核 PASS（6445499937）。两个 ui 文件不改是实测结论：渲染器读的就是服务端已翻译的文档。

1. **形态:** a draft PR to `main` whose body opens with `Fixes #26112` and `Fixes #26142` on separate lines. No closing keyword sits next to any other card. 19 paths, +645 / −27. `check-governed-merges --pr 26757`: NOT governed, 672 lines ≤ 3000, so the ordinary queue landing applies.
